infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FleetCaring needs camera access to capture pre/post-service vehicle photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FleetCaring needs your location while on duty so dispatch can route jobs to you.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: FleetCaring tracks your location during your shift — including in the background — so dispatch can route jobs to you and customers can see your ETA. It stops the moment you end your shift.
